Condition : 1 - The details submitted pursuant to condition 22 (pontoon) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and the following policies of the Unitary Development Plan ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-W.1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area), ENV-W.1.7(Use of the River Thames for Passenger Transport), ENV-W.1.9 (Use of the River Thames for Recreational Activities), ENV-W.1.10 (The Thames Path National Trail and Access to the River) and ENV-W.1.11(Access to the Thames Foreshore); subject to an additional condition as follows:
(22)(i)
The pontoon shall not be installed prior to closure of the adjacent bridge arch to navigation, with written confirmation from the Port of London Authority being submitted to the Local Planning Authority that the following requirements from the Port of London Harbour Master have been met:
(vi)	The adjacent Kew Bridge arch has been permanently closed to navigation, including recreational craft, with this to be advertised by statutory notice.
(vii)	The arch closure is appropriately indicated as follows:
(a)	By day, three red discs 0.6 metres in diameter at the points of an equilateral triangle with the apex downwards and the base horizontal. 
(b)	By night, three red lights in similar positions to the discs displayed by day. 
(viii)	The bridge owner has agreed to the display of the signs and the supply of electricity.

(ix)	There is agreement as to the party that is responsible for the upkeep of the sign.

description: Details details of construction, materials and operation of the pontoon to the River Thames; and life saving equipment required by Condition 22  of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 01/07/2010 for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use).
